services.name: Exhibit Fund
services.desc: Get up close and personal with the fascinating creatures that live just outside our doors! Learn about whales and other marine mammals of the Gulf of Maine, about the work we do to protect them, and how you can be a part of the solution. Witness its beauty outside, then come indoors to learn more about Our Dynamic Gulf of Maine! Our newly redesigned Gulf of Maine exhibit helps visitors understand the urgency and hope of this unique, highly productive, and rapidly changing ecosystem. Discover what research scientists are learning about the health of, and changes in, fish stocks and local coastal ecosystems by observing common terns that inhabit the Isles of Shoals' White and Seavey

services.name: Treks Summer Camp
services.desc: Kids love our camps! Whether onsite or field-trip-based (grades 6-8), our camp programs spark curiosity and empower kids to see themselves as scientists and naturalists, excited about discovering the world around them. Our camp counselor are knowledgeable and skilled educators, who are able to ignite children’s enthusiasm for science through engaging, hands-on learning experiences. With our low camper-to-counselor ratio tailored for each age group, we create a safe, enriching, and personalized experience for every camper.
